products.title: WARDROBE 3-LEAF WITH UPPER CABINET (LOFT) CARYS HM10887.12 MELAMINE IN NATURAL/GREY 150x55.5x240Hcm
products.description:
The three-leaf wardrobe CARYS combines functionality and modern design. The construction of high-quality melamine in a combination of NATURAL wood and GREY colors with black metal handles offers durability and elegance, while the two practical drawers at the bottom enhance ergonomics. The upper cabinet (loft) is divided into 3 equally sized compartments, which close with a double and a single door. All 3 doors have vertical black metal handles, while the interior of the compartments is empty. They do not have shelves or anything else and are suitable for storing bulky items.
An ideal solution for bedrooms looking for organization with style and discreet luxury.
---------------------------------------------------
DIMENSIONS:
150x55.5x240H cm. (including the upper loft)
Upper cabinet (loft) height: 60 cm.
Inside left: 48x54x41H cm. (without the loft)
Inside right: 48x54x26H cm. (without the loft)
Hanging space: 97x54x102H cm. (without the loft)
Drawers: 92x35x18H cm.
Melamine thickness: 16mm
---------------------------------------------------
CONSTRUCTION MATERIALS:
The wardrobe is made of high-quality melamine. Melamine is a type of wood in chipboard form, very durable and with great hardness, making it very resistant to scratches, abrasion, and stains.
---------------------------------------------------
MAINTENANCE:
Melamine, which is the construction material, is particularly durable and is very easily cleaned of stains thanks to its hard surface. You can wipe all surfaces with a damp cloth and if there are persistent stains you can use a mild cleaner.
----------------------------------------------------

products.title: PROFESSIONAL UMBRELLA LADIN HM6550 HEAT TRANSFER STEEL--ECRU SHADE Φ270x270Hcm.
products.description:
Professional Round Umbrella LADIN Φ270cm. – Premium Boho Shading—HEAT TRANSFER/ECRU

Upgrade the aesthetics of your professional space, pool or garden with the Professional Umbrella LADIN. Combining absolute stability with a timeless Boho design, this umbrella features a perimeter flap with elegant fringes that attract attention. It is the ideal choice for beach bars, hotels, cafes, but also for luxurious home verandas that seek high-standard shading with unparalleled style.
---------------------------------------------------------
Top Quality Construction & Functionality
• Durable Wood-Look Frame: The central steel pole (Φ38x0.75mm) has a special Heat Transfer paint treatment, offering the "warmth" and elegance of natural wood, along with the robustness and resistance of steel against corrosion.
• 360° Shading Flexibility: Equipped with a rotation and tilt mechanism in the upper part, it allows you to adjust the shading angle precisely, offering continuous protection from the sun at all hours of the day.
• Easy Handling: Opening and closing the umbrella is done effortlessly and in a few seconds thanks to the built-in lift with ergonomic crank.
• High Wind Resistance: The 8 fiberglass spokes (Φ8.5mm) provide excellent elasticity and resistance to strong winds, preventing the deformations experienced by common metal frames.
• Premium Shade Cloth: The 100% spun polyester 200g fabric in ECRU color guarantees maximum absorption of ultraviolet rays (UV), high resistance to fading from the sun and effective water repellency.
--------------------------------------------------------
Technical Specifications
• Type: Professional / Premium Round Umbrella
• Shade Diameter: Φ270 cm.
• Pole Height: 270 cm.
• Pole Cross-section: Φ38 mm x 0.75 mm
• Pole Material: Steel with Heat Transfer paint (wood effect)
• Ray Material: Fiberglass Φ8.5 mm
• Fabric: Spun Polyester 200g/m² with perimeter fringes (flap)
• Functions: Opening crank, Tilt mechanism, Rotation system
________________________________________
Use & Maintenance Instructions
1. In Severe Weather: In case of strong winds, severe storms or blizzards, the umbrella must always remain closed.
2. Dry Storage: Do not close or store the umbrella when the fabric is still damp or wet, as there is a risk of mold and stains forming. Allow it to dry completely in an open position.
3. Fabric Cleaning: Clean the polyester fabric locally using a soft sponge or brush with lukewarm water and mild, neutral soap. Avoid using strong chemical cleaners or bleach.
4. Off-Season Protection: During the winter months, store the umbrella in a shady, dry and well-ventilated area.

products.description:
STRATUS Gaming Chair – Ultimate Comfort, Durability & Anatomical Design (Black)

Take your gaming setup or workspace to the next level with the STRATUS gaming chair. Designed with a body-hugging bucket aesthetic, the STRATUS offers the ideal balance between a sporty look and ergonomic support. It is the perfect choice for gamers and professionals looking for a sturdy, stylish and affordable chair for long-term use.
________________________________________
Product Dimensions:
• Overall Dimensions: 62 x 62 x 109 - 119 (Height) cm.
• Seat Dimensions: 32 x 49 cm.
• Back Dimensions: 49 x 73 cm.
________________________________________
Technical Features & Specifications:
• Top-notch Upholstery: Fully upholstered with high-quality PVC leather in a timeless black color, offering a premium feel and excellent wear resistance.
• Sturdy Frame: Internal metal frame for superior stability, with a reinforced seat base made of 1.3 cm thick recycled wood.
• Hybrid Comfort Foam: 5 cm total seat thickness, consisting of 4 cm recycled foam for stable support and 1 cm primary foam for a soft feel to the touch.
• Fixed Armrests: Ergonomically designed armrests with integrated soft padding, which offer a stable resting point for the wrists and elbows.
• Durable Base: Five-spoke base made of reinforced polypropylene (PP) with a radius length of 32 cm for absolute balance, equipped with durable PP wheels for smooth rolling.
• Certified Class 2 suspension with guaranteed weight resistance up to 110 kg.
• Extra Anatomical Support: Includes two removable cushions for full support of the head (neck) and lumbar (waist).
________________________________________
What is the "Multifunctional" Mechanism?

products.description:
The LIMNOS wooden beach chair with arms in NATURAL impregnated color is a modern and luxurious proposition for the beach. Its wooden construction makes it incredibly durable and sturdy and comes with GREY textilene fabric which matches the NATURAL-colored frame beautifully. products.title: DINING TABLE OVAL RODDEN HM11903.02 WERZALIT TABLETOP IN BLACK/GOLD MARBLE LOOK-BLACK METAL BASE 146x94x75Hcm.
products.description:
RODDEN is an oval dining table with features that rank it among the best in its class. It has a beveled oval tabletop (professional level) in BLACK/GOLD MARBLE coloring, which is suitable for contact with food and the material is generally environmentally friendly. It can be used either indoors or outdoors. This tabletop rests on a BLACK metal base/leg in a double cross arrangement with height adjusters at the bottom.
-----------------------------------------------
DIMENSIONS:
146X94x75H cm.
Leg distance: 132x72 cm.
Tabletop thickness: 20.5mm
-----------------------------------------------
CONSTRUCTION MATERIALS:
The tabletop is made of Werzalit. Werzalit is a lightweight, strong, dense, and synthetic material that is resistant to scratches, temperature fluctuations and stains, while its performance is stable (i.e., it has tremendous durability) even under the harshest indoor and outdoor conditions. The surface can withstand heat up to 180 degrees Celsius (356F) without getting burned and will not show burn marks from cigarettes or hot plates. This material is the result of a patented process that uses specialized machinery that creates enormous pressure to mold wood grains and resin into usable shapes.

The base is metal with powder-coating. Powder coating is a dry coating process used as a metal finish. Powder coating is applied as dry powder through an electrostatic process, then cured with heat.
-----------------------------------------------
MAINTENANCE:
Werzalit is easy to clean and maintain, making it a hygienic surface. It doesn’t require any special cleaners. The base only needs is a dusting and when necessary, a cleaning with a damp cloth.
-----------------------------------------------

products.title: CEILING PENDANT LAMP TREIT HM4875 DRIFTWOOD IN NATURAL 48x54x52-73Hcm.[1xΕ27]
products.description:
TREIT Pendant Ceiling Light: The Natural Charm of Driftwood

Renew the aesthetics of your home or business space with the handmade TREIT ceiling light. Made of natural driftwood (seawood), each piece is unique, carrying its own story sculpted by the salt and waves of the sea.
Its rustic design, combined with the raw beauty of the wood, creates a warm and welcoming atmosphere, ideal for those who love boho, coastal or eco-friendly decoration styles.
----------------------------------------------
Technical Features:
• Construction Material: Genuine natural Driftwood.
• Dimensions: 48x54x52-73H cm.
• Lamp Type: Accepts 1 bulb with E27 socket (LED is recommended to save energy and highlight the waters of the wood).
• Style: Rustic, Boho, Natural.
----------------------------------------------
What is Driftwood?
Driftwood is wood that has been drifted by water (sea, lakes or rivers) and has undergone natural processing by the elements of nature. The sun and salt dry it naturally, giving it a unique texture, bleached appearance and excellent durability. It is a sustainable and environmentally friendly material.
----------------------------------------------
Maintenance Instructions:
1. Cleaning: Use a soft, dry cloth or a soft-bristled brush to remove dust from the crevices of the wood.
2. Avoid Moisture: Although it comes from water, as an indoor piece of furniture it is advisable to avoid direct contact with water or chemical cleaners that may alter its color.
---------------------------------------------
*The package does not include a light bulb.

• Style: Rustic, Boho, Natural.
• It features hangers on the back to hang with nails.
----------------------------------------------
What is Driftwood?
Driftwood is wood that has been drifted by water (sea, lakes or rivers) and has undergone natural processing by the elements of nature. The sun and salt dry it naturally, giving it a unique texture, bleached appearance and excellent durability. It is a sustainable and environmentally friendly material.
----------------------------------------------
Maintenance Instructions:
1. Cleaning: Use a soft, dry cloth or a soft-bristled brush to remove dust from the crevices of the wood.
2. Avoid Moisture: Although it comes from water, as an indoor piece of furniture it is advisable to avoid direct contact with water or chemical cleaners that may alter its color.

Aluminum can also be recycled indefinitely, maintaining its characteristics without any quality degradation.
Info: Powder coating is a dry coating process used as a metal finish. Powder coating is applied as dry powder through an electrostatic process, then cured with heat.

products.description:
We present to you “PUNDER”. An excellent and beautifully designed outdoor rectangular dining table in bright shades of cream white/beige. The excellent construction materials, such as aluminum and Sintered Stone, combine and give an aesthetically beautiful result with a perfect finish in every detail.
-------------------------------------------------------------------
DIMENSIONS:
220x100x76H cm.
Leg distance: 187x91 cm.
-------------------------------------------------------------------
CONSTRUCTION MATERIALS:
-Powder coated aluminum. Aluminum is a "green" material that can be recycled indefinitely, maintaining its characteristics without any quality degradation. Aluminum is corrosion resistant by nature.

- Sintered stone has nothing to do with real stone since that is its scientific term. It is a matrix (mold) of minerals, such as granite, quartz, pieces of glass, etc., which are heated (fused) to form a solid impermeable mass resulting in a surface that cannot be scratched, etched, burned, or soiled. In fact, even in its properties, this material is very similar to ceramic, but it is even better!
-------------------------------------------------------------------
MAINTENANCE:
In addition to regular dusting, you can wipe with a damp cloth. Do not use chemical cleaners, like bleach etc.
-------------------------------------------------------------------
ADVANTAGES:
•Durability: Aluminum and Sintered stone are suitable for outdoor use.
•Sturdiness and Comfort
•Easy maintenance: Easy cleaning with mild detergents.

JAVANTE 2.7x2.7m Aluminum Umbrella with Water Base with Side Pole (hanging) & 360° Rotation – WHITE Shade
_________________________________________
Product Description
The professional JAVANTE umbrella combines modern design and advanced construction, offering ideal shade for a pool, garden or terrace. With a minimal aesthetic in bright WHITE tones and a side pole (hanging), it creates an elegant and functional relaxation space.
The durable aluminum construction and reinforced iron elements ensure stability and long life, while the powder coating protects against external conditions. The mechanism with a handle and foot pedal at the bottom of the pole allows easy use and 360° rotation, offering flexibility in shading throughout the day.
The 250g polyester fabric with UV resistance (1000 hours) offers effective protection from the sun, while the integrated ventilated opening (skylight) enhances stability in windy conditions.
The umbrella rests on a water base made of durable reinforced P.E. (polyethylene), which is filled with water or a mixture of water and sand, reaching up to 160kg in weight, offering strong support, while it also has wheels for easy transport!

JAVANTE is an ideal choice for those looking for premium aesthetics and high functionality in outdoor spaces.

products.description:
POLLIN Outdoor Aluminum Umbrella with Gas Spring Mechanism and Acrylic Shade—Light Gray

The POLLIN outdoor umbrella combines classic design, sturdy construction and absolute functionality. Made of anodized aluminum, it ensures robustness and resistance to corrosion and weather conditions, making it an ideal choice for a garden, swimming pool, hotel or cafeteria.
The umbrella has an air vent for better air circulation and an automatic hydraulic opening (gas spring pull), offering ease of use. The acrylic fabric shade effectively protects against solar radiation, while maintaining the aesthetics of the umbrella unchanged over time.
The umbrella comes with a separate steel base in the same color, tube type ("cup"), which is included in the package, with dedicated holes to screw the umbrella to the ground.
________________________________________
Specifications
Overall dimensions: 5 x 5 x 4.10H meters.
• Aluminum pole dimensions: Φ80x2.5mm—anodized
• Pole height: 4.10 meters
• Steel tube-type base with screw plate dimensions at the base 28x28cm
• Spokes: 12 aluminum spokes with steel reinforcement internally in the longest spokes for maximum strength
• Aluminum spoke dimensions: 20x30x1.2mm
• Shade diameter: 5x5 meters one-piece without perimeter flaps—Acrylic water-repellent fabric 340g with UV50+ sun protection
• Mechanism: Hydraulic opening with gas spring
• Color: Light Gray

**5 YEAR COLOR GUARANTEE ON SHADE FABRIC**

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Maintenance
• Clean the aluminum with a soft cloth and mild soap.
• The fabric is easy to clean with water and mild detergent.
• It is recommended to store or cover the umbrella during periods of non-use.
________________________________________
What we like
• Durable aluminum construction.
• Hydraulic opening for ease of use.
• Shade made of superior quality acrylic fabric
• Unique design

-- Suitable mainly for professional use

products.description:
GLADELL Professional Round Umbrella with Air Spring Mechanism—BEIGE

The GLADELL umbrella combines a classic round design with an airduct on the top, sturdy construction and absolute functionality. Made of HEAT TRANSFER (special wood coloring) aluminum and polyethylene compounds, it ensures robustness and resistance to corrosion and weather conditions, making it an ideal choice for a garden, swimming pool, hotel or cafeteria.

The umbrella features easy opening with hydraulic assistance (air spring pull), offering ease of use. Specifically, there is a special opening marking from a specific point and then easy opening with a lever on the aluminum pole. The spun polyester fabric shade effectively protects against solar radiation, while maintaining the aesthetics of the umbrella unchanged over time, while at the "attachment" points of the fabric to the frame there is a double layer of fabric for extra durability. (When the umbrella is closed, the shade is tied with fabric straps with "velcro")

[The umbrella comes without a base, allowing you to choose how to support it.]
________________________________________
Specifications
Overall dimensions: Φ3 meters.---Height: 2,40m
• Aluminum pole dimensions: Φ48x1.2mm—HEAT TRANSFER (The pole is articulated (extendable) and has a lock/open mechanism for opening it)
• Spokes: 8 aluminum spokes 14x24x1.0mm
• Shade diameter: Φ3 meters one-piece without perimeter flaps—Spun Polyester water-repellent fabric 300g with UV50+ sun protection. Spun poly (spun polyester) is a type of polyester fabric created from polyester fibers, and unlike plain polyester, it gives the final fabric a feel and appearance reminiscent of cotton, while maintaining the durable properties of polyester.
• Mechanism: opening with air spring and hydraulic assistance
• Color: BEIGE

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Maintenance
• Clean the aluminum with a soft cloth and mild soap.
• The fabric is easily cleaned with water and a mild detergent.
• It is recommended to store or cover the umbrella when not in use.
________________________________________
What we like
• Durable HEAT TRANSFER aluminum construction.
• Hydraulic opening for ease of use.
• Elegant BEIGE colored shade.
• Ideal for professional and domestic outdoor spaces.

--Suitable for professional and domestic use

products.description:
GLADELL Professional Umbrella with Screw Tube Base and Air Spring Mechanism—BEIGE

The GLADELL umbrella combines a classic square design with an airduct on the top, sturdy construction and absolute functionality. Made of HEAT TRANSFER (special wood coloring) aluminum and polyethylene compounds, it ensures robustness and resistance to corrosion and weather conditions, making it an ideal choice for a garden, swimming pool, hotel or cafeteria.

The umbrella features easy opening with hydraulic assistance (air spring pull), offering ease of use. Specifically, there is a special opening marking from a specific point and then easy opening with a lever on the aluminum pole. The spun polyester fabric shade effectively protects against solar radiation, while maintaining the aesthetics of the umbrella unchanged over time, while at the "attachment" points of the fabric to the frame there is a double layer of fabric for extra durability. (When the umbrella is closed, the shade is tied with fabric straps with "velcro")

[The umbrella comes without a base, allowing you to choose how to support it.]
________________________________________
Specifications
Overall dimensions: 3 x 3 x 2.50H meters.
• Aluminum pole dimensions (one-piece): Φ58x1.5mm—HEAT TRANSFER
• Pole height: 2.50 meters
• Spokes: 8 aluminum spokes 14x24x1.0mm
• Shade diameter: 3x3 meters one-piece without perimeter flaps—Spun Polyester water-repellent fabric 300g with UV50+ sun protection. Spun poly (spun polyester) is a type of polyester fabric created from polyester fibers, and unlike plain polyester, it gives the final fabric a feel and appearance reminiscent of cotton, while maintaining the durable properties of polyester.
• Mechanism: opening with air spring and hydraulic assistance
• Color: Beige

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Maintenance
• Clean the aluminum with a soft cloth and mild soap.
• The fabric is easily cleaned with water and a mild detergent.
• It is recommended to store or cover the umbrella when not in use.
________________________________________

• Durable heat transfer aluminum construction.
• Hydraulic opening for ease of use.
• Elegant design in beige color.
• Ideal for professional and domestic outdoor spaces.

products.description:
The TRUDI armchair in DUSTY PINK color with SILVER metal frame is beautiful. The feature that makes this armchair stand out is that it is round with the back being separate from the seat. The entire armchair is upholstered in high-quality warm boucle fabric, which makes it beautiful and a focal point in your living room. It combines style and comfort, and you can place it next to the fireplace, a window or even in your bedroom, and let yourself be embraced by it.

84x79x76H cm.
Seat height: 46 cm.
Seat dimensions: 48x59 cm.
Arm height: 64 cm.
Leg distance: 67x58 cm.
Backrest dimensions: 50x32 cm.

CONSTRUCTION MATERIALS:
The frame of the armchair, on which both the back and the seat are mounted, is metal. The same frame ends at the legs of the armchair which are joined together with a metal cross arrangement. The whole construction is sturdy and durable.
The "fillings" of the armchair, both on the back and on the seat, are made of medium hardness foam materials that offer great comfort and better body support.
The entire upholstery of the armchair has been made of excellent quality boucle fabric. This is any fabric that has a knot-curl in its weave. It is made of almost all raw materials (although it is usually synthetic) with special knotted threads or highly twisted threads, so that it has a curly surface. It does not wrinkle and can be plain, melange, checkered or tweed.

MAINTENANCE:
You can wipe the boucle fabric with a vacuum cleaner, while in case of stains use a slightly wet cloth.

ADVANTAGES:
• Sturdy construction
• Aesthetically wonderful armchair
• Ease of maintenance
• High legs
• Amazing value for money
• Easy assembly
• Ready for delivery

•The characteristic, however, of this table is its surface. This is made of tempered glass or safety glass. Tempered or toughened glass is a type of safety glass about four times stronger than ordinary glass. And unlike ordinary glass, which can shatter into jagged shards when broken, tempered glass fractures into small, relatively harmless granular pieces. As a result, tempered glass is used in those environments where human safety is an issue, like home applications etc.
-----------------------------------------------------

From the above it is clear that no special maintenance is needed. A wipe with a damp cloth or even with special cleaners is enough.

products.title: DOUBLE BED & MATTRESS KENDRA HM10831.18 BLUE VELVET WITH STORAGE SPACE--FOR 160x200cm
products.description:
• The KENDRA bed, in dimensions for a mattress of 160x200 cm, is sufficiently comfortable to accommodate two people. It has a headboard with two pillows tied to it (removable with a zipper), to provide comfort when you sit down to read your book, while its entire upholstery is made with excellent quality velvet fabric in impressive BLUE color. The mattress "sits" on two rows of anatomical slats, while the frame with these mattress slats is lifted with a metal safety mechanism with 2 gas lifts, offering a large storage space, which of course occupies all the space down to the floor.

• The mattress that accompanies the bed has dimensions of 160x200cm and is of independent spring technology (pocket springs) and Double-sided which means that you can turn it over regularly.
---------------------------------------------------------
DIMENSIONS:
External Dimensions: 177x221x98H cm.
Footboard and sides height: 28 cm.
Storage space dimensions: 160Χ200Χ20H cm.
Mattress dimensions 160x200 cm.-----Mattress height: 19 cm.
-----------------------------------------------------------
CONSTRUCTION MATERIALS:
The bed is made of wood, which gives it strength and durability, while the storage mechanism is metallic.
The upholstery is entirely made of high-quality velvet fabric, giving an attractive look and a sophisticated charm to the bedroom decoration, especially with the quilted pattern on the headboard cushions.
----------------------------------------------------------
MAINTENANCE:
To keep the velvet clean and fluffy, it's a good idea to vacuum it once a week. Attach a soft brush, set the mild program on your vacuum, and sweep the entire surface in the direction of the grain. You will see that immediately the dust will be removed, and the pile of fabric will be like new. In no case should you rub a velvet fabric. Even if you must remove a stain, don't scrub it. Moisten a soft cloth with water and dab locally on the stain.

*The product is delivered unassembled in factory packaging

products.title: COFFEE TABLE OVAL MONTANA SUPERIOR HM9906 ACACIA WOOD-METAL 120x61x45Hcm.
products.description:
OVAL COFFEE TABLE MONTANA SUPERIOR
-------------
Discover this unique oval coffee table with a tabletop made of natural solid ACACIA wood in NATURAL color. It has legs in a beautiful cross arrangement in BLACK color. The modern design meets nature and gives a timeless and warm feeling to your space, while at the same time it is a piece of furniture of superior quality and statement.
--------------------
DIMENSIONS:
120x61x45H cm.
Leg spacing: 64x35 cm.
Tabletop thickness: 4 cm.
---------------------
CONSTRUCTION MATERIALS:
-The bases are made of reinforced metal in black color and at the bottom of the legs there are plastic pads for protection of the floors.
-The tabletop is made of natural solid acacia wood and each one is unique due to the unevenness of the tree trunks. When we refer to solid wood, we mean wood made entirely from the trunk of a tree. Solid wood is the most expensive choice in terms of wood but stands out for its timeless aesthetics.

**The existing cracks or those that may be created over time are due to the contraction-expansion of the living organism called solid wood, and are not a manufacturing defect, giving originality and unique design to your space. During the production process, existing cracks are smoothed and stabilized with material made from the same wood. Therefore, there may be color variations and differences in product dimensions due to the dimensions of the treated wood. These are not a product defect.

products.title: MATTRESS DOUBLE SILENTIUM HM749.06 POCKET SPRINGS--WHITE 160x200x30Hcm
products.description:
Introducing the brand new SILENTIUM mattress series!

This mattress sports POCKET SPRINGS and it is single-sided.

A healthy sleeper changes his sleeping position up to sixty times a night (to avoid muscle and joint pain). The ability to change one's position without being hindered is a necessary condition for a restorative sleep. The even distribution of pressure prevents pain in the body where there can be the greatest pressure (shoulders, hips, heels) and guarantees good blood circulation.

This DOUBLE mattress integrates the technology of independent springs which is one of the most popular types of mattresses. The heart of the mattress consists of many independent innersprings enclosed in a cylindrical cloth, the pocket. Each innerspring is firmly packed with the adjacent springs. This technique enables the springs to move independently of others nearby. This complex technique makes pocket mattresses adaptable to the shape of the body.
-----------------------------------------------------------
SPECIFICATIONS:
Dimensions: 160x200 cm.
Mattress height: 30 cm.
• 100% knitted polyester surface
• A layer of Cellucotton (3000-fill-count) cotton batting provides insulation and reinforcement between the springs and the surface materials.
• 1cm of super soft cotton
• 3.5cm of wavy foam of specifications 20kg/m3
• 2cm of foam 25kg/m3
• A layer of padding with polyester fiber cotton of specifications 200g/m2
• Pocket spring springs with spring height of 25cm and specifications Φ1.8mm metal wire—2 (two) rows of pocket springs around the perimeter of dimension Φ2.2mm
• A layer of padding with polyester fiber cotton of specifications 200g/m2
• A layer of woven fabric with warp and woof 170g/m2 which, thanks to its construction, maximizes the comfort and "breathability" of the mattress

HARDNESS: 2/5

-----------------------------------------------------------
MAINTENANCE:
• Periodically expose your mattress to the sun for proper ventilation
• Leave windows open for 30 minutes every day to remove moisture, especially during the winter which is the main cause of mattress odor
• Do not bend the mattress because there is a risk of deformation and destruction
• Do not use as a "trampoline" by children
• Keep it dry
• Wash the sheets at high temperatures and iron them well to kill various microorganisms and place them dry on top of the mattress
• Do not iron on the mattress
• Protect it from liquids and clean it locally only with special cleaners
• The base of the mattress must be free of protrusions, curves, and bumps. It should be on a straight surface
-----------------------------------------------------------
ADVANTAGES:
• Roll-pack for easy transport
• Protection from insects such as mites etc.
• Ventilated
• Anatomical

-----------------------------------------------------------

products.title: MATTRESS SEMI-DOUBLE HYPNOTTICA HM748.02 POCKET SPRINGS--WHITE 120x200x25Hcm
products.description:
Introducing the brand new HYPNOTTICA mattress series!

This mattress sports POCKET SPRINGS and it is single-sided.

A healthy sleeper changes his sleeping position up to sixty times a night (to avoid muscle and joint pain). The ability to change one's position without being hindered is a necessary condition for a restorative sleep. The even distribution of pressure prevents pain in the body where there can be the greatest pressure (shoulders, hips, heels) and guarantees good blood circulation.

This SEMI-DOUBLE mattress integrates the technology of independent springs which is one of the most popular types of mattresses. The heart of the mattress consists of many independent innersprings enclosed in a cylindrical cloth, the pocket. Each innerspring is firmly packed with the adjacent springs. This technique enables the springs to move independently of others nearby. This complex technique makes pocket mattresses adaptable to the shape of the body.
-----------------------------------------------------------
SPECIFICATIONS:
Dimensions: 120x200 cm.
Mattress height: 25 cm.
• 100% polyester knitted fabric surface
• A layer of sprayed adhesive polyester fibers weighing 300g/m2 that provides insulation and reinforcement between the springs and the surface materials.
• 2.5cm of wave-rolled foam of specifications 20kg/m3
• Non-woven fabric of grammage 25g/m2
• 1cm of foam of specifications 25kg/m3
• 1 layer of cotton felt of weight 200g/m2
• Pocket springs with spring height 22cm and specifications Φ1.8mm steel wire—2 (two) perimeter rows of pocket springs of dimension Φ2.2mm
• 1 layer of cotton felt of grammage 200g/m2
• Perimeter lining with grey warp-knitted fabric, which thanks to its construction maximizes air circulation and contributes to better regulation of the temperature of the mattress


HARDNESS: 2/5

-----------------------------------------------------------
MAINTENANCE:
• Periodically expose your mattress to the sun for proper ventilation
• Leave windows open for 30 minutes every day to remove moisture, especially during the winter which is the main cause of mattress odor
• Do not bend the mattress because there is a risk of deformation and destruction
• Do not use as a "trampoline" by children
• Keep it dry
• Wash the sheets at high temperatures and iron them well to kill various microorganisms and place them dry on top of the mattress
• Do not iron on the mattress
• Protect it from liquids and clean it locally only with special cleaners
• The base of the mattress must be free of protrusions, curves, and bumps. It should be on a straight surface
-----------------------------------------------------------
ADVANTAGES:
• Roll-pack for easy transport
• Protection from insects such as mites etc.
• Ventilated
• Anatomical

-----------------------------------------------------------

The JAVANTE outdoor umbrella is hanging with tilt capability and combines modern design, sturdy construction and absolute functionality. The umbrella rotates 360 degrees, offering unique flexibility in placement. The acrylic fabric shade effectively protects against solar radiation, while maintaining the aesthetics of the umbrella unchanged over time.

products.description:
Introducing the new premium TOREN office chair. Premium office chairs are not just a functional seat; they are an element of prestige and aesthetics that essentially upgrades any professional space. Designed with an emphasis on detail, they combine impeccable assembly of materials, sturdy construction and a refined image, creating a presence that exudes quality and professionalism.

The upholstery made of superior quality PU leather offers the elegance and feel of leather, with high durability in use and ease of care. Its surface is soft to the touch, while maintaining its durability even in a demanding daily work environment.

The base is 5-spoke metal, chrome-plated, ensuring stability, durability and timeless shine. The polyurethane-coated casters offer quiet and smooth rolling, while protecting the floor and allowing flexible movement without vibrations or noise.

The perfect union of all the individual elements — from the mechanism to the seams of the upholstery — creates a set of high aesthetic and ergonomic excellence. The result is an office chair that enhances the image of the space, offers everyday comfort and reflects the quality and professionalism of the company that hosts it.
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
“TOREN” office chair features—Green

•Upholstery with excellent PU leather in GREEN color
•Quality foam on the seat, armrests, and the tall back, with emphasis on the headrest
•5-beam base made of chromed metal (Φ35cm)
•Chromed caster wheels 60mm with polyurethane layer
•Gaslift Class 3 (Chromed)
•“BUTTERFLY” mechanism with height and recline settings

------------------------------------------------------------------------
DIMENSIONS:
66x74x128H cm.
------------------------------------------------------------------------
CONSTRUCTION MATERIALS:
•The steel suspension can withstand up to 120 kg of weight (class 3 gas-lift).
•PU leather is known as faux leather or synthetic leather has the texture of linen fabric. Synthetic leather is the evolution of leatherette and cannot be easily distinguished from real leather.
------------------------------------------------------------------------
MAINTENANCE:
•The caster wheels should be cleaned with a cloth and of course the accumulated hairs that get tangled in the rolling shafts should be removed so the chair doesn’t "jam".

products.description:
Introducing the new premium TEETER office chair. Premium office chairs are not just a functional seat; they are an element of prestige and aesthetics that essentially upgrades any professional space. Designed with an emphasis on detail, they combine impeccable assembly of materials, sturdy construction and a refined image, creating a presence that exudes quality and professionalism.

The upholstery made of superior quality PU leather offers the elegance and feel of leather, with high durability in use and ease of care. Its surface is soft to the touch, while maintaining its durability even in a demanding daily work environment.

The base is 5-spoke metal, chrome-plated, ensuring stability, durability and timeless shine. The polyurethane-coated casters offer quiet and smooth rolling, while protecting the floor and allowing flexible movement without vibrations or noise.

The perfect union of all the individual elements — from the mechanism to the seams of the upholstery — creates a set of high aesthetic and ergonomic excellence. The result is an office chair that enhances the image of the space, offers everyday comfort and reflects the quality and professionalism of the company that hosts it.
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

“TEETER” office chair features--Beige

•Upholstery with excellent textured PU leather in BEIGE color
•Quality foam on the seat and the tall back, especially on the headrest
•Fixed arms with PU leather covers, in BEIGE color
•5-beam base made of chromed metal (Φ35cm)
•Caster wheels with polyurethane layer
•Gaslift Class 3 (Chromed)
•Height and 3-position recline adjustment with lock capability
•Anatomical design

------------------------------------------------------------------------
DIMENSIONS:
67x66x121H cm.
------------------------------------------------------------------------
CONSTRUCTION MATERIALS:
•The metallic suspension can withstand up to 120 kg of weight (class 3 gas-lift).
•PU leather is known as faux leather or synthetic leather has the texture of linen fabric. Synthetic leather is the evolution of leatherette and cannot be easily distinguished from real leather.
------------------------------------------------------------------------

•The caster wheels should be cleaned with a cloth and of course the accumulated hairs that get tangled in the rolling shafts should be removed so the chair doesn’t "jam".

products.description:
The SONTY office chair combines ergonomics, high quality construction and sophisticated design, essentially upgrading any professional space. Made with durable materials and thoughtful details, it offers stability and long-lasting comfort. Its modern aesthetics enhance the prestige image of the office, creating an environment that exudes professionalism and attention to detail.

“SONTY” office chair features—Light Grey

•Upholstery with excellent textured PU leather in LIGHT GREY color
•Quality foam on the seat and the tall back, especially on the headrest
•Fixed arms with PU leather covers, in LIGHT GREY color
•5-beam base made of chromed metal (Φ35cm)
•Caster wheels with polyurethane layer
•Gaslift Class 3 (Chromed)
•Height and 3-position recline adjustment with lock capability
•Anatomical design

products.title: CORNER SOFA (RIGHT) COVEN HM3266.14R GREEN FABRIC 298x102-208x85Hcm.
products.description:
Introducing COVEN, a wonderful large sofa in a RIGHT corner configuration (as you look at it) upholstered in quality fabric in GREEN color. Starting from the design, the sofa reaches very low in an "apron" style, and it has wide and short legs-bases in black color. The arms are impressively wide, while the upholstery is in a quilted style with bold stitching! The piece that forms the corner has the same aesthetic and is connected to the main sofa with vertical panel hangers. The backrest is low and has 4 back cushions with long narrow cylindrical cushions on the back for better support, as well as 3 smaller decorative pillows. The seat has medium hardness foam fillings combined with pocket springs, offering unparalleled comfort. And of course, we offer this sofa with a 3-year frame warranty!
-----------------------------------------------------------------
DIMENSIONS:
298x102-208x85H cm.
Seat dimensions: 220x62-168x61-103 cm.
Back dimensions: 250x44 cm.
Arm height: 55 cm.
Seat height: 40 cm.
Foam specifications: DNS 29
-----------------------------------------------------------------
CONSTRUCTION MATERIALS:
The frame of the sofa is made of pine wood and eucalyptus wood. PINE is a soft, white or pale-yellow wood that is light in weight with straight grain lines. Resists shrinkage, swelling and bending. EUCALYPTUS is a hardwood that is considered one of the sustainable woods that are both useful and environmentally friendly. Not only the wood looks absolutely attractive but also shares many qualities with similar hardwoods. It is very strong, and it has a high density.
-----------------------------------------------------------------
MAINTENANCE:
A simple dusting and a wipe with a damp cloth in case of simple stains is enough for cleaning. For more difficult stains, dry cleaning is recommended. Do not use chemical cleaners.
-----------------------------------------------------------------
*The sofa is delivered in factory packaging, unassembled

Premium Bioclimatic Aluminum Pergola
DOMECIL HM6612.01 – 300x400x240cm | Black

Discover the ultimate outdoor living experience with a premium bioclimatic pergola that combines architectural aesthetics, advanced functionality and top-notch construction quality. DOMECIL is not just a shading solution — it is a complete upgrade of your space.

ARCHITECTURAL ELEGANCE & CONTEMPORARY DESIGN

The clean geometry, strict lines and deep BLACK finish create an imposing yet discreet presence. Ideal for modern homes, villas, rooftop spaces and professional projects with high demands.

BIOCLIMATIC ENVIRONMENTAL CONTROL TECHNOLOGY
Rotating METAL louvers offer:
• Natural cooling through adjustable ventilation
• Shading adjustment depending on the time of day
• Creation of an ideal microclimate under the structure

The manual mechanism VIA A CRANK HANDLE operates smoothly and reliably, allowing precise adjustment with minimal effort, while the integrated water channels in the pergola columns help to perfectly remove water in case of rain.

HIGH-QUALITY CONSTRUCTION
• Reinforced high-strength aluminum frame
• Resistance to moisture, sun and weather changes
• Powder coating for long-term preservation of the finish
• Stable, sturdy structure with a premium sense of security
• Aluminum columns: 100x100x1.3 mm
• Aluminum beams (4): 120x79x1.55 mm
• Iron louvers specifications: 27x138.6x0.7 mm
• Roof: single-layer, with spray-type surface treatment

Aluminum offers low MAINTENANCE requirements and excellent durability over time.
• Cleaning with a soft cloth and mild detergent
• Avoiding abrasive and acidic products
• Periodic inspection of the blind mechanism

DIMENSIONS THAT OFFER FREEDOM OF CONFIGURATION
-300x400cm total external dimensions including ground bases
-272x372cm usable internal space

With a coverage area of 12 sq.m. (300x400cm) with a weight of 163kg and a height of 240cm, creates a fully functional space for:
• Premium lounge set
• Dining room for 8-10 people
• Outdoor dining concept
• Boutique hospitality applications

THE EXPERIENCE IT OFFERS
DOMECIL transforms the outdoor space into a private core of relaxation and hospitality. The light is filtered with precision, the air circulates naturally and the environment acquires a high aesthetic character.

For demanding spaces that do not compromise
• Premium architectural aesthetics
• Bioclimatic function adapted to your needs
• Durable and long-lasting materials
• Ideal for luxury homes & professional applications

DOMECIL is not just a pergola.
It is an investment in the way you live your outdoor space.

products.description:
Premium Bioclimatic Aluminum Pergola
FRANIO HM6610.01 – 300x400x240cm | Black

Discover the ultimate outdoor living experience with a premium bioclimatic pergola that combines architectural aesthetics, advanced functionality and top-notch construction quality. FRANIO is not just a shading solution — it is a complete upgrade of your space.

Architectural elegance & contemporary design

The clean geometry, strict lines and deep BLACK finish create an imposing yet discreet presence. Ideal for modern homes, villas, rooftop spaces and professional projects with high demands.

Bioclimatic environmental control technology
Rotating ALUMINUM louvers offer:
• Natural cooling through adjustable ventilation
• Shading adjustment depending on the time of day
• Creation of an ideal microclimate under the structure

The manual mechanism VIA A CRANK HANDLE operates smoothly and reliably, allowing precise adjustment with minimal effort, while the integrated water channels in the pergola columns help to perfectly remove water in case of rain.

High-quality construction
• Reinforced high-strength aluminum frame
• Resistance to moisture, sun and weather changes
• Powder coating for long-term preservation of the finish
• Stable, sturdy structure with a premium sense of security
• Aluminum columns: 100x100x1.6 mm
• Aluminum side crossbeams (left & right): 100x79x1.5 mm
• Aluminum central crossbeam: 105x134x1.5 mm

Aluminum offers low MAINTENANCE requirements and excellent durability over time.
• Cleaning with a soft cloth and mild detergent
• Avoiding abrasive and acidic products
• Periodic inspection of the blind mechanism

Dimensions that offer freedom of configuration
-300x400cm total external dimensions including ground bases
-272x372cm usable internal space

With a coverage area of 12 sq.m. (300x400cm) with a weight of 125kg and a height of 240cm, creates a fully functional space for:
• Premium lounge set

• Outdoor dining concept
• Boutique hospitality applications

The experience it offers
FRANIO transforms the outdoor space into a private core of relaxation and hospitality. The light is filtered with precision, the air circulates naturally and the environment acquires a high aesthetic character.

For demanding spaces that do not compromise
• Premium architectural aesthetics
• Bioclimatic function adapted to your needs
• Durable and long-lasting materials
• Ideal for luxury homes & professional applications

FRANIO is not just a pergola.
It is an investment in the way you live your outdoor space.

-- The tabletops are made of sintered stone. Of course, it has nothing to do with real stone since that is its scientific term. Sintered stone, therefore, is a matrix (mold) of minerals, such as granite, quartz, pieces of glass, etc., which are heated (fused) to form a solid impermeable mass resulting in a surface that cannot be scratched, etched, burned, or soiled. In fact, even in its properties, this material is very similar to ceramic, but it is even better!

CARE:

products.title: HPL TABLETOP HM5841.23 ROUND IN WHITE Φ60cm.
products.description:
Round beveled tabletop in WHITE color, which is suitable for contact with food. In general, the material is environmentally friendly. It can be used in various places such as cafes, restaurants, and tourist accommodation, either indoors or outdoors.

**INSTALLATION ADVANTAGE:
This tabletop has German Slots on the back of it ("guides") in which the special square-headed screws (included in the package) fit, and you can adjust their distance along the "guide", so that it matches the base you have. So, screw the tabletop on the base you have (square or cross), and then tighten it with the washers that are also included in the package. In this way, you completely avoid drilling the tabletop.

DIMENSIONS:
Φ60cm.
Thickness: 12mm.
Base ‘‘guides” width: from 25x25cm to 55x55cm (screw according to the size of your base)

CONSTRUCTION MATERIAL:
The tabletop is made of HPL. Its real name is High Pressure Laminate 'HPL'. It consists of boards covered with sheets of synthetic materials that look like wood. As a material it has a matte or glossy finish. Its main characteristics are its resistance to impacts, abrasion and stains, its resistance to the creation of bacteria and finally its color stability to sunlight and artificial lighting. It also shows resistance to high temperatures, with excellent resistance to fire, scratches and it is particularly resistant to water.

products.title: ARMCHAIR WITH MANUAL RECLINER BRAYLEN HM3298.01 GREY VELVET 85x90x95Hcm.
products.description:
BRAYLEN with GREY velvety upholstery, is an armchair that, visually, fills everyone's senses with its rich dimensions and comfortable cushions. The backrest is high, and the seat is deep and comfortable. The arms invite you to spread your hands on their rich cushions and when you come home from work and want to relax in front of your TV, or read your newspaper, or your favorite book in front of the window, then the relax mechanism with the elegant lever on the side of the armrest lowers the back and in combination with the folding footrest will offer you unique moments of relaxation. Finally, the storage “pocket” on the outer side of the armrests offers another practical solution for everyday use.


DIMENSIONS:
85x90x95H cm.
Seat dimensions 44x50 cm.
Backrest dimensions 80x60 cm.
Seat height: 46 cm.
Armrest height: 52 cm.
Maximum reclining dimension: 44x155x76H cm.
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
CONSTRUCTION MATERIALS
The entire armchair is upholstered in high quality velvety fabric, which gives the feeling of luxury and aesthetically upgrades your space. Velvet is a soft, relaxed, delightful, and elegant fabric that is impossible to resist. The positive thing is that it can be easily harmonized with any type of decoration, offering refinement and elegance.
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
MAINTENANCE:
Thanks to the durable construction materials, the armchair is user-friendly. As a matter of fact, to keep the velvet clean and fluffy, it's a good idea to vacuum it once a week. Attach a soft brush, set the mild program on your vacuum, and sweep the entire surface in the direction of the grain. You will see that immediately the dust will be removed, and the pile of fabric will be like new.
In no case should you rub a velvet fabric. Even if you must remove a stain, don't scrub it. Moisten a soft cloth with water and dab locally on the stain.
An ideal choice for cleaning velvet is also leather (that is, the cloths with which we dry the car).
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
ADVANTAGES:
•Sturdy construction

products.title: HPL TABLETOP HM6351.36 ROUND IN SONAMA OAK Φ120cm.
products.description:
Round beveled tabletop in SONAMA OAK color, which is suitable for contact with food. In general, the material is environmentally friendly. It can be used in various places such as cafes, restaurants, and tourist accommodation, either indoors or outdoors.

DIMENSIONS:
Φ120cm.
Thickness: 12mm.

CONSTRUCTION MATERIAL:
The tabletop is made of HPL. Its real name is High Pressure Laminate 'HPL'. It consists of boards covered with sheets of synthetic materials that look like wood. As a material it has a matte or glossy finish. Its main characteristics are its resistance to impacts, abrasion and stains, its resistance to the creation of bacteria and finally its color stability to sunlight and artificial lighting. It also shows resistance to high temperatures, with excellent resistance to fire, scratches and it is particularly resistant to water.

In case you wish to have the HPL surface pre-drilled by our company, the cost amounts to 4 euros per piece.

Important note:
Before installing the screws, you should check their size to avoid surface damage.
(If the wrong screws are installed the surface will be damaged as the screws penetrate it. To avoid damage to the product it is recommended to check the screw size before it is installed on the surface, even if the screws are from our company or you buy them on the market.)

** The color rendering of the product may differ slightly from its photographic representation on your screen.

This tabletop has German Slots on the back of it ("guides") in which the special square-headed screws (included in the package) fit, and you can adjust their distance along the "guide", so that it matches the base you have. Its main characteristics are its resistance to impacts, abrasion and stains, its resistance to the creation of bacteria and finally its color stability to sunlight and artificial lighting. MEMFIS Outdoor Aluminum Lounge Set – Apricot

Upgrade your outdoor space with the impressive MEMFIS aluminum lounge set, in a subtle apricot shade. A complete set that combines modern aesthetics, luxury, and durability to enjoy comfortable moments of relaxation in the garden, terrace or patio.
The set includes a 3-seater sofa, two armchairs of the same design and two round tables with ceramic tabletops, creating an elegant and functional outdoor seating area.
________________________________________

Features:
• Elegant aluminum frame, lightweight and rust-resistant, with powder coating.
• Back upholstery with apricot colored rope Φ5mm diameter for a modern effect and comfort.
• Removable seat and back cushions with 200g polyester apricot-colored covers, durable and easy to wash.
• Ceramic apricot-colored tabletops with heat, scratch and stain resistance — easy to clean and highly resistant to outdoor conditions.
• Ergonomic design with ideal seat height and high-quality fillings for long-lasting comfort.
________________________________________

o Aluminum specifications: Φ38mm / Φ25mm / Φ22mm / Φ19mm / Φ13mm / 50x20mm

• Fabric: Polyester 200g
• Table surfaces: Ceramic
o Scratch-resistant

________________________________________

ROBIN Dining Chair in Teak and VIRO Rope in Natural Color

The ROBIN dining chair combines timeless design, natural elegance and durable construction. With a solid teak frame and a VIRO rope seat, it is an ideal choice for those looking for a quality wooden dining chair with a natural aesthetic and a long lifespan.
Teak is one of the most durable and luxurious hardwoods, known for its stability and high resistance to wear and tear and time. The minimal back in natural finish and the VIRO rope offer excellent seating comfort with style. ROBIN is ideally suited to indoor dining rooms, but also to hospitality spaces such as restaurants or hotels that desire a natural and refined atmosphere.

• Armrest height: 65 cm.

________________________________________
Materials
• Solid high-quality teak wood, resistant to wear and weather conditions.
• Synthetic VIRO rope on the seat, elastic and durable, offers comfort and durability over time.
• Natural finish that highlights the texture and color of the wood.
________________________________________
Maintenance
• Teak is maintained by periodically applying a special oil for wood, so that it remains shiny and protected.
• Cleaning is done with a soft cloth and mild soap.
• VIRO rope is cleaned with water and a soft brush, without the use of chemicals.
________________________________________
Advantages
• Sturdy construction made of natural solid teak wood.

• Comfortable seat made of durable VIRO rope.
